title: SpiderFingerprintSnapshotPayload
description: Payload for event_type=spider.fingerprint_snapshot, schema_version major=1. MirageSpider's live observation of the §6.5 fingerprint checklist for the sandbox instance it runs on — the same 8 named checks infra/fingerprint/baseline.schema.json defines, collected live (Step 10's fingerprint gate consumes the latest one per sandbox_id before allowing SANDBOX_ACTIVE -> ENGAGING), as opposed to Step 9a's build-time-only collection. Carried in the shared envelope (Appendix C). sandbox_id deliberately has no foreign-key coupling to sandbox_instances (Step 9b) at the schema layer — Appendix G: 'If the Controller fails, observation continues... the two are never combined,' so Spider's own reporting must not depend on the Controller's lifecycle.

checks.description: One entry per §6.5 named check — {check_name: {...observation-specific fields...}}, the exact shape libs/mirage_common/fingerprint.py::run_fingerprint_check's `observed` parameter expects. Per-check shape depends on that check's comparator (same variability infra/fingerprint/baseline.schema.json's own `expected` field documents), so each is loosely typed here.
